verdict.rationale: Sprinto is a SaaS compliance platform with its own AI features (the AI Editor and AI evidence gap analysis), so a training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents a setting or policy that keeps customer data out of AI model training. Its AI governance module (Shadow AI discovery, AI risk scoring, vendor due diligence) helps organisations govern their own AI systems and vendors. That is an adjacent capability and earns no credit toward a personal or tenant training opt-out.
